items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: the guy's name was Jack Tebo who came to me... He said, 'You'll be perfect.' ... He said, 'You'll learn the thing, they all played, it'll be simple for you.'

ctx.x: And it was in the Spring, I think around April. Or May, around the first of May. And we'd do an audition for the people in the Fine Arts Building. Ah, it was -- wait a minute, what was the name of that girl. Anyway the guy's name was Jack Tebo who came to me, I remember his name, and he said, (unintelligible) going off in the summer, Chattanooga; the fellow had to be operated on. We need somebody and I can't find anybody. He said, 'You'll be perfect.' I said, 'But I can't read, I don't know' -- He said, 'You'll…
Weren't you kind of thrilled though?
